solar.title: Solar Energy
solar.description: We install residential, commercial and industrial photovoltaic systems tailored to your energy needs.
solar.fullDescription: We specialize in the design, installation and maintenance of photovoltaic solar energy systems in El Salvador. With over 10 years of experience, we have implemented grid injection, solar lighting and energy monitoring projects throughout the national territory. Our systems adapt to each client: from homes to large industrial facilities.
solar.f2: Residential and industrial solar panel installation
solar.f4: Solar lighting for outdoor and public spaces

security.title: Electronic Security
security.description: CCTV systems, monitoring centers and video surveillance with cutting-edge technology to protect your business.
security.fullDescription: We design and implement comprehensive electronic security solutions for businesses, institutions and public spaces. Our video surveillance systems combine state-of-the-art hardware with intelligent monitoring software. We integrate CCTV cameras with solar energy to ensure continuous operation even without grid connection.

tech.title: Technology
tech.description: Hardware, software and specialized technical support to optimize your company's operations.
tech.fullDescription: We provide complete technology solutions for Salvadoran businesses: from hardware and equipment sales to specialized software implementation and continuous technical support. Our team of experts ensures your technology infrastructure operates optimally and securely, with guidance at every stage of the process.
tech.f3: Specialized on-site and remote technical support

timeline.e1_desc: Grupo Suntech begins operations in El Salvador with a focus on energy and technology solutions for the national market.
timeline.e2_desc: We completed our first photovoltaic grid injection projects, establishing our reputation in renewable energy.
timeline.e3_desc: We incorporated the electronic security and CCTV line, expanding our comprehensive technology service offering.
timeline.e4_desc: We became an authorized Huawei partner, gaining access to world-class photovoltaic technology.
timeline.e5_desc: We expanded our presence to Sonsonate, Santa Ana, Armenia and other regions with larger-scale, high-impact projects.
timeline.e6_desc: We launched the hardware, software and enterprise technical support division, completing our three strategic lines.
timeline.e7_desc: We surpassed 50 delivered projects throughout El Salvador, consolidating our position as sector leaders.
timeline.e8_desc: We implemented solar monitoring centers with 5G connectivity in Los Chorros, pioneering this technology in the country.
timeline.e9_desc: We surpassed 109 completed projects nationwide, with presence in San Salvador, Sonsonate, Santa Ana and beyond.
timeline.e10_desc: We launched our digital platform and strengthened our online presence to serve more clients throughout Central America.
timeline.e11_desc: We continue growing as a benchmark in solar energy and technology, with new large-scale, high-impact projects for El Salvador.
